name: smugri-mt-bench
description:
SMUGRI-MT-Bench
	

This is a Finno-Ugric version of MT-Bench created to evaluate the multi-turn conversation and instruction-following capabilities of LLMs. It covers 4 (extremely) low-resource Finno-Ugric languages: Estonian, Livonian, Komi and Võro.
SMUGRI-MT-Bench comprises of 80 single and multi-turn questions organized into four topics: math, reasoning, writing, and general. The questions are handpicked from LMSYS-Chat-1M dataset and manually translated into Estonian, Võro, Komi… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/tartuNLP/smugri-mt-bench.
evaluation_method: LLM-based preference scoring (automated pairwise/score comparisons) / human_eval-style judgments
reputation: A niche, community-driven benchmark aimed at evaluating LLMs on extremely low-resource Finno-Ugric languages; valuable for low-resource multilingual evaluation but limited in scale.
